text:
maria: quick heads-up — opened PR to add migration note + release blurb for the model catalog change (deprecate model-legacy-x). PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/912
kevin: saw it, thanks. can you add a short snippet showing the SDK param rename? that's the part PMs care about.
sam: also we need to coordinate merge timing with the infra deploy — don't want live API switching before docs land. pinging infra leads separately.
maria: yes — thinking merge in the 48h merge window on Monday so CI/docs preview has time to run and we can fix any rendering issues.
alex: FYI docs preview is flaky with the big model table, it times out in Netlify. we should either split the table or move it behind an expandable section.
maria: noted. I'll try folding the table with a collapsed details block first.
kevin: for the SDK snippet, use this minimal example and drop into the migration guide: 
```python
from redwood import RedwoodClient
client = RedwoodClient(api_key="$RW_KEY")
# old
resp = client.generate(model="model-legacy-x", response_mode="balanced")
# new
resp = client.generate(model="model-new-x", response_style="balanced")
```
alex: perfect. also add a short compatibility note: older SDKs will error on unknown param. include a sample error message.
sam: on reviewers — can we get @kevin, @alex, and @jordan as primary reviewers? jordan can confirm release blurb tone.
kevin: I can review today after standup. alex will check rendering + examples. jordan is OOO Fri but back Monday so that matches merge window.
maria: thanks. tagging docs-bot to request the docs preview job once I push the table collapse change.
docs-bot: queued docs preview for PR #912 — build 2148. Status will post here.
ci-bot: build 2148 started (docs-preview). Netlify build step: running.
ci-bot: build 2148 failed — markdown rendering error: "Unexpected HTML in table cell" at docs/model-catalog.md: line 312.
alex: yep that's the table cell with the long JSON example. we need to move that JSON into a separate code block file and include via snippet include.
maria: moving JSON to snippets/model-compat.json and referencing it. pushing patch now.
docs-bot: queued docs preview for PR #912 (rebased) — build 2150.
ci-bot: build 2150 succeeded — preview URL: https://preview.docs.redwood.ai/pr-912
kevin: review done — comments inline about wording. small nit on "deprecated" phrasing.
alex: rendering looks good. code examples render OK.
maria: addressed comments and updated release blurb per kevin. leaving a note in the PR about merge ordering: 
- wait for infra deploy to flip model-new-x as default
- merge docs PR after infra flip confirmed
- cut release notes draft in releases repo after merge
sam: approved, sounds safe. added a small checklist in the PR description for the release engineer.
maria: thanks everyone — will keep this thread updated when infra confirms. :thumbsup:
ci-bot: PR #912 merged by maria at 1842007921
kevin: great, thanks. i'll coordinate the release notes publish step with marketing.
maria: closing loop — infra confirmed flip at 1842007200, merge happened after confirmation. will follow up if any rollback needed.
